evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、pyproject.toml、openviking/server/routers/content.py、openviking/storage/viking_fs/_semantic.py、openviking/server/routers/search.py、openviking/service/search_service.py、openviking/retrieve/hierarchical_retriever.py、openviking/storage/viking_vector_index_backend.py、openviking/storage/scope_filter.py、openviking/server/routers/resources.py、openviking/server/resource_ingest.py、openviking/service/resource_service.py、openviking/server/routers/tasks.py、openviking/storage/queuefs/semantic_ops/freshness_policy.py、openviking/storage/queuefs/semantic_processor.py、openviking/server/config.py、openviking/server/auth/plugins/dev.py、openviking/storage/abstract_overview.py；资源摄入可后台登记任务。检索把目录及授权范围传给向量后端，按请求模式可选用会话规划与候选重排；原文与目录摘要有各自的读取接口。
limitations: 核查根 Python 服务的普通资源摄入、find 和 search、分层读取与开发认证。其他检索模式、DSH 子包、部署后端差异、会话提取和基准收益未核验。静态 inventory 的指定扩展名没有覆盖实际 Python 和 Rust 规模。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 维护 Agent 项目资料的团队，可以把授权资料组织成有 URI 的目录，再为问答找出可复查的原文。
资源摄入可后台登记任务。检索把目录及授权范围传给向量后端，按请求模式可选用会话规划与候选重排；原文与目录摘要有各自的读取接口。
核查根 Python 服务的普通资源摄入、find 和 search、分层读取与开发认证。其他检索模式、DSH 子包、部署后端差异、会话提取和基准收益未核验。静态 inventory 的指定扩展名没有覆盖实际 Python 和 Rust 规模。
根包 pyproject.toml 动态生成版本，声明 Python 服务和命令行入口。固定提交不由 README 基准版本推断，当前未下载或验收发布制品。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 存储、向量索引及模型请求 | 配置身份与目录，摄入样本 | 初次耗时和费用未知 |
| 持续使用 | 查询、摘要重算与后台队列 | 维护语料、监看任务和核对原文 | 单位合格任务开支未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 重建或补写需要资源 | 对照任务、摘要和原文定位停点 | 中断恢复时间未知 |
| 退出 | 原文件与测试库的数据留存 | 停止摄入并核对权限和外部模型处理 | 未实测删除和迁移耗时 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 使用已有原文件可恢复的隔离样本。先以一个目录的问题验证任务回执、结果路径、逐字原文，再试一个禁止访问的目录。如果授权或更新状态无法解释，保留原有搜索并停止摄入新资料。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 来源追溯 | 路径查询、分层读与独立原文入口 | 正确引用率与节时 |
| 有范围检索 | 目录进入向量查询条件 | 目标后端和权限配置的实际效果 |
| 后台摄入 | 有任务回执和等待分支 | 祖先摘要完成时间和准确率 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的调用方目录范围不会由会话规划改写，意图失败保留原查询。[Q03](#research-q03) 给异步摄入可查询状态，并把父摘要刷新做成有条件的独立传播。
[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 显示，服务将有范围的查询和可独立读取的 URI、摘要与原文放在同一个接口模型中。它能缩短从命中候选到回查原文的操作路径，但尚未测定同任务的检索质量。
[Q03](#research-q03) 显示摄入接受、任务完成及父摘要覆盖最新内容是不同阶段。大目录可能等待累积变化，锁忙时本轮传播可以跳过，所以单凭可读摘要不能确认资料更新已反映在答案里。
[Q05](#research-q05) 提出将可核验的新鲜度信息与有权限的原文回查绑定，测试能否减少引用陈旧事实。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3.10 或更新、服务存储 | 自部署需要 | 启动服务并保存资源 | 无法提供持久上下文 |
| 向量存储与嵌入器 | 语义检索需要 | 形成索引并执行语义查询 | 语义查找不可用 |
| 配置的 VLM | 生成摘要、启用意图等流程 | 生成分层文本或规划查询 | 对应流程受限，意图失败会回到原查询 |
| 正确身份和资料授权 | 共享部署和敏感数据处理需要 | 控制访问与处理范围 | 暂停扩大接入 |

technical.rationale: 以原文搜索与带目录标签的向量索引为参照。[Q01](#research-q01) 的 URI 与分层是小幅组合新意，无法据此判断先例优先。机制的实质增量是路径范围贯穿检索到可回查读；[Q02](#research-q02) 保持调用方约束且可在意图失败时退化。该模式可迁移到有可授权文件层和范围过滤的库，需相应后端。层级读与搜索合并简化操作面，但 [Q03](#research-q03) 的异步状态仍须验收。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的流程把整理目录、语义找候选、逐字回查连成一条路径。交付从回答文本扩展为可回查的来源候选，取实质增量。API 能让已有基础设施团队接入，但 Python、模型和权限维护限制覆盖，只取小幅。摘要先读可能减少不必要的原文阅读，仍有摄入与重新生成开支，[Q04](#research-q04) 无单位合格任务账单，经济增量只作小幅结构判断。

recommendation.reason: 维护 Agent 项目资料的团队可用独立测试库摄入一批可公开文档，并核对问答所指的原文。相比逐个翻找项目文件，它将语义检索限定在指定目录并提供摘要和原文读取入口。若命中跨越授权范围，或无法解释旧摘要与原文的差别，应暂停采集并回到原文件搜索。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的目录问答和精确引用构成重复任务，README 42–62 与 content.py 168–193 提供该组织方式。多项目定位、核实和接入现有 Agent 的摩擦比仅能描述用例更具体，取较充分档。尚无该目标人群持续需求的直接记录，未到充分。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的可浏览来源和 [Q02](#research-q02) 的 _semantic.py 452–486 明确相比手工找文档有范围与规划增量，超过入口包装。带元数据过滤的现有索引仍可解决部分问题，且 [Q03](#research-q03) 的旧摘要边界影响可交付，未达较充分档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的 _semantic.py 210–254、hierarchical_retriever.py 202–264 与 [Q03](#research-q03) 的 resource_service.py 2251–2274 覆盖实际查询和后台处理边界，强于只有 README。作者基准属于另一实验条件，没有本次同版本运行，未到本地测试档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 的 server/config.py 441–453 和 dev.py 31–55 使身份约束可检查，独立库并保留原文件提供退出路，超过恢复不明档。仍需配置模型、验证外发与隔离、处理后台任务，且单位成本未知，未到负担较轻档。

# OpenViking > 为 AI Agent 组织、浏览、检索与复用知识、记忆和技能的上下文数据库。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[volcengine/OpenViking](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 4bd28b5783d4fd4126ae15beebf5f19730c47219](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/tree/4bd28b5783d4fd4126ae15beebf5f19730c47219)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-08（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 已有依据支持目录范围查询、分层读取及摄入任务状态。父摘要的更新边界可由源码确定。新鲜度提示的任务收益属于待验证假设。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：维护 Agent 项目资料的团队，可以把授权资料组织成有 URI 的目录，再为问答找出可复查的原文。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 显示，服务将有范围的查询和可独立读取的 URI、摘要与原文放在同一个接口模型中。它能缩短从命中候选到回查原文的操作路径，但尚未测定同任务的检索质量。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 显示摄入接受、任务完成及父摘要覆盖最新内容是不同阶段。大目录可能等待累积变化，锁忙时本轮传播可以跳过，所以单凭可读摘要不能确认资料更新已反映在答案里。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 提出将可核验的新鲜度信息与有权限的原文回查绑定，测试能否减少引用陈旧事实。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 使用已有原文件可恢复的隔离样本。先以一个目录的问题验证任务回执、结果路径、逐字原文，再试一个禁止访问的目录。如果授权或更新状态无法解释，保留原有搜索并停止摄入新资料。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 显示，服务将有范围的查询和可独立读取的 URI、摘要与原文放在同一个接口模型中。它能缩短从命中候选到回查原文的操作路径，但尚未测定同任务的检索质量。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 显示摄入接受、任务完成及父摘要覆盖最新内容是不同阶段。大目录可能等待累积变化，锁忙时本轮传播可以跳过，所以单凭可读摘要不能确认资料更新已反映在答案里。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 提出将可核验的新鲜度信息与有权限的原文回查绑定，测试能否减少引用陈旧事实。 用同一公开语料固定两个目录、两种身份和一份版本变更，核对目标权限、任务终态、引用正确率、延迟与人工核实成本。 ## 场景与替代办法 维护 Agent 项目资料的团队，可以把授权资料组织成有 URI 的目录，再为问答找出可复查的原文。 同语料下以原文件的关键词搜索为基线，并与已有目录元数据过滤的向量索引比较；如果目录、引用与来源已有统一维护，新增服务的收益会缩小。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | Python 3.10 或更新、服务存储 | 自部署需要 | 启动服务并保存资源 | 无法提供持久上下文 | | 向量存储与嵌入器 | 语义检索需要 | 形成索引并执行语义查询 | 语义查找不可用 | | 配置的 VLM | 生成摘要、启用意图等流程 | 生成分层文本或规划查询 | 对应流程受限，意图失败会回到原查询 | | 正确身份和资料授权 | 共享部署和敏感数据处理需要 | 控制访问与处理范围 | 暂停扩大接入 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 建立隔离库 | 操作者配置服务、模型和测试身份 | 仅使用非敏感资料，入口和身份可核实 | | 摄入资料 | 操作者选定项目目录，保存 task_id | 轮询任务终态，再确认原文和摘要 | | 核查 | 开发者给问答指定目录，对照返回 URI 与原文 | 没有越权返回，答案可追溯到目标资料 | | 退出 | 操作者停止新增资料，保留源文件与原搜索入口 | 可以在原库继续工作，再核对测试数据和外部留存 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次使用 | 存储、向量索引及模型请求 | 配置身份与目录，摄入样本 | 初次耗时和费用未知 | | 持续使用 | 查询、摘要重算与后台队列 | 维护语料、监看任务和核对原文 | 单位合格任务开支未测 | | 失败恢复 | 重建或补写需要资源 | 对照任务、摘要和原文定位停点 | 中断恢复时间未知 | | 退出 | 原文件与测试库的数据留存 | 停止摄入并核对权限和外部模型处理 | 未实测删除和迁移耗时 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 来源追溯 | 路径查询、分层读与独立原文入口 | 正确引用率与节时 | | 有范围检索 | 目录进入向量查询条件 | 目标后端和权限配置的实际效果 | | 后台摄入 | 有任务回执和等待分支 | 祖先摘要完成时间和准确率 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：维护项目知识的 Agent 平台团队，能否通过 OpenViking 的目录范围和分层检索更可靠地找到可回查原文，并明确需要自管的数据、身份及后台任务？ ### Q01 · 团队为何要把项目资料变成可浏览的上下文库？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 维护多项目 Agent 知识的团队可把项目资料、记忆和技能组织为可寻址的 viking:// 资源。相比手工维护文档加关键词搜索，目录摘要和语义查找提供两个查阅入口，操作者仍可回到具体资源核查事实。相比只有候选片段的平面向量索引，这里增加了可浏览的 URI、分层读取与可指定的目录范围；有相同元数据过滤的现成索引也能覆盖部分需求。服务将 abstract、overview 和 read 分开，摘要路径在传入文件时可能返回父目录摘要。需要逐字证据时应读源文件而非把父目录概览当文件内容。根 Python 包暴露独立服务和 CLI，本项研究对象是上下文基础设施。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:42-62](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/4bd28b5783d4fd4126ae15beebf5f19730c47219/README.md#L42-L62) 作者描述 URI 文件系统、目录搜索和分层访问。
查看原文（21行） ```text ## What is OpenViking OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents — one filesystem for everything an agent knows: knowledge, memory, and skills. Most agent memory is a black box: text goes in, embeddings come out, and nobody can see what was actually stored. OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem under `viking://` instead. Agents navigate it like files — `ls`, `tree`, `read`, `write`, `grep` — and you can open any directory to inspect and edit what your agent knows. Every directory carries a generated summary, so agents can scan summaries first and decide what to read. [Try OpenViking Studio](https://studio.openviking.ai) in your browser, no installation required. [Self-host Web Studio](web-studio/README.md). ## Why OpenViking - **One filesystem for knowledge, memory, and skills.** Resources hold documents and code; memories retain user preferences and experience; skills define how to perform tasks — not just extracted facts, but the full context, each with a `viking://` URI for browsing and retrieval. → [Viking URI](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/04-viking-uri) · [Context types](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/02-context-types) - **Search a directory, not the whole index.** Scope semantic search to a project or memory subtree instead of scanning a flat vector pool. `find` runs a query directly; `search` plans retrieval from session context. → [Retrieval](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/07-retrieval) - **Read the summary before the source.** Generated directory abstracts (L0) and overviews (L1) let agents judge relevance before opening full content (L2). → [Context layers](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/03-context-layers) - **Sessions become files you can read.** Committing a session archives the conversation and extracts memories as Markdown you can inspect, edit, and merge. \n\n\n \n \n \n \n\n\n### The Context Database for AI Agents\n\nEnglish / [中文](docs/repository/README_CN.md) / [日本語](docs/repository/README_JA.md)\n\nWebsite · Live Demo · GitHub · Issues · Docs · Blog\n\n

\n\n\n\n
\n\n***\n\n## What is OpenViking\n\nOpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents — one filesystem for everything an agent knows: knowledge, memory, and skills.\n\nMost agent memory is a black box: text goes in, embeddings come out, and nobody can see what was actually stored. OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem under `viking://` instead. Agents navigate it like files — `ls`, `tree`, `read`, `write`, `grep` — and you can open any directory to inspect and edit what your agent knows. Every directory carries a generated summary, so agents can scan summaries first and decide what to read.\n\n\n \n \n \n \n\n\n[Try OpenViking Studio](https://studio.openviking.ai) in your browser, no installation required. [Self-host Web Studio](web-studio/README.md).\n\n## Why OpenViking\n\n- **One filesystem for knowledge, memory, and skills.** Resources hold documents and code; memories retain user preferences and experience; skills define how to perform tasks — not just extracted facts, but the full context, each with a `viking://` URI for browsing and retrieval. → [Viking URI](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/04-viking-uri) · [Context types](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/02-context-types)\n- **Search a directory, not the whole index.** Scope semantic search to a project or memory subtree instead of scanning a flat vector pool. `find` runs a query directly; `search` plans retrieval from session context. → [Retrieval](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/07-retrieval)\n- **Read the summary before the source.** Generated directory abstracts (L0) and overviews (L1) let agents judge relevance before opening full content (L2). → [Context layers](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/03-context-layers)\n- **Sessions become files you can read.** Committing a session archives the conversation and extracts memories as Markdown you can inspect, edit, and merge. With VikingBot enabled, `ov compile` organizes source material into a wiki, knowledge graph, or report. → [Sessions](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/08-session) · [Context compilation](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/context-compilation/01-overview)\n\n[Architecture](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/01-architecture) · [Design rationale](https://blog.openviking.ai/post/openviking-context-database/)\n\n```\nviking://\n├── resources/ # Resources: project docs, repos, web pages, etc.\n│ └── my_project/\n│ ├── docs/\n│ │ ├── api/\n│ │ └── tutorials/\n│ └── src/\n└── user/\n └── {user_id}/\n ├── memories/\n │ └── preferences/\n │ ├── writing_style\n │ └── coding_habits\n ├── resources/\n │ └── private_project/\n ├── skills/\n │ ├── search_code\n │ └── analyze_data\n └── peers/\n └── web-visitor-alice/\n```\n\nThe three loading tiers:\n\n- **L0 (Abstract)**: a one-sentence summary for quick relevance checks.\n- **L1 (Overview)**: core information and usage scenarios for planning.\n- **L2 (Details)**: the full original data, read only when needed.\n\nSemantically processed directories carry L0/L1 summaries, so agents can judge relevance before reading full files:\n\n```\nviking://resources/my_project/\n├── .abstract.md # L0: quick relevance check\n├── .overview.md # L1: structure and key points\n└── docs/\n ├── .abstract.md\n ├── .overview.md\n └── api/\n ├── auth.md # L2: full content, loaded on demand\n └── endpoints.md\n```\n\n## Proof it works\n\nOpenViking 0.3.22 has been evaluated on long-conversation user memory (LoCoMo) and multi-turn agent tasks (tau2-bench). Full results and setup details, including knowledge-base QA, are in the [benchmark report](https://blog.openviking.ai/post/openviking-benchmark-results/); reproduction scripts live in [./benchmark](./benchmark).\n\nTo run your own experiments, follow the [RAG and Memory evaluation guide](benchmark/README.md) for routine VikingBot memory evaluation, published LoCoMo reproduction, separate mem0 prompt comparisons, and RAG evaluation.\n\nThe memory evaluation used [Doubao 2.0 Pro](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:cn-beijing/model/detail?Id=doubao-seed-2-0-pro) as the VLM and [Doubao-embedding-vision-251215](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:cn-beijing/model/detail?Id=doubao-embedding-vision) as the embedding model.\n\n\n \n \n\n\n- **User memory (LoCoMo)**: with OpenViking, all three agent integrations land at 80–83% accuracy — up from 24–57% on their native memory — while input tokens drop by 34.3–91.0% and query latency by 58.45–66.10%.\n- **Agent experience (tau2-bench)**: experience memory lifts task success by +6.87pp (retail) and +11.87pp (airline) over the same LLM without memory.\n\n## Quick start\n\nSet up an OpenViking server first; if you already have one, skip to [Use it with your agent](#use-it-with-your-agent). Deploying your own needs uv, Python 3.10+ and a model provider with an embedding model and a VLM.\n\n
\nLet your agent deploy it\n\n```text\nFollow this guide to install and start an OpenViking Server for me:\n\nhttps://docs.openviking.ai/en/getting-started/04-setup-for-agent\n\nAsk me for the model provider, the models, the workspace directory and whether\nother machines need to reach the server; don't guess. When you ask for the model\nAPI key, tell me how to hand it over if I'd rather not paste it into this chat,\nand never repeat it back.\n\nWhen it's running, tell me the server's address and whether auth is turned on.\n```\n\nYour agent will first ask which model provider to use and for its API key.\n\n
\n\n
\nDeploy it yourself\n\nInstall OpenViking and run the setup wizard, which configures the models:\n\n```bash\nuv tool install openviking --upgrade && openviking-server init\n```\n\n`init` writes `~/.openviking/ov.conf` and supports Volcengine, OpenAI, Codex OAuth, Kimi, GLM and local Ollama; see the [configuration guide](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/guides/01-configuration). The server runs in the foreground, so keep this terminal open.\n\n
\n\n
\nUse OpenViking Service (hosted by Volcengine)\n\nThe same OpenViking service, run for you by Volcengine. The first 50 files are free. Activate it on the [Volcengine product page](https://www.volcengine.com/product/openviking-service?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=readme), then create an API key in the console under User Management → API Key. The server address is `https://api.vikingdb.cn-beijing.volces.com/openviking`; you'll need it and the API key when you connect your agent.\n\n
\n\n### Explore with the CLI\n\nThe `openviking` package includes the `ov` CLI. With the server running, import a repository and search it:\n\n```bash\nov status\nov add-resource https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking\n# Replace TASK_ID with the returned task_id; repeat until status is completed\nov task status TASK_ID\nov ls viking://resources/\nov tree viking://resources/volcengine -L 2\nov find \"what is openviking\"\nov grep \"openviking\" --uri viking://resources/volcengine/OpenViking/docs/en\n```\n\n`ov find` returns matching context with URIs you can inspect. For client configuration (`ov config`), standalone CLI installs, and index maintenance, see [CLI setup](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/getting-started/05-cli-setup).\n\nBuild your own integration with the [Python](sdk/python/README.md), [Go](sdk/go/README.md), or [TypeScript](sdk/typescript/README.md) SDK, or the [HTTP API](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/api/01-overview).\n\n## Use it with your agent\n\nConnect your coding agent to OpenViking for cross-session memory. The memory plugin installer covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, TRAE, OpenCode and more, and detects which ones you have.\n\n
\nLet your agent install it\n\n```text\nInstall the OpenViking memory plugin and help me start using it. OpenViking is a context database for AI agents (https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking); the command and link below are from its official docs.\n\n1. Run the official installer. It needs network access and writes to my home directory; if your sandbox blocks that, ask me for approval:\n curl -fsSL https://openviking.ai/install | bash -s -- --yes --lang en --url --api-key \n2. Once it's installed, read the OpenViking onboarding guide and use it to walk me through setup. The guide has you ask me before choices like importing history or adding a working rule. docs.openviking.ai and docs.openviking.net are the same docs site; use whichever loads:\n https://docs.openviking.ai/agents/en/onboarding.md\n\nThe API key is a user key I created for myself on that server; the installer stores it in ~/.openviking/ovcli.conf on this machine. Use it in the command as it is; there's no need to show it in your replies, and don't write it into any other file or rule. Talk to me in English.\n```\n\nBefore you send it, replace `` with your server's address and `` with a user key; a root key can't read or write memories. If the server has auth turned off, use `--api-key ''`.\n\n
\n\n
\nInstall it yourself\n\nRun the installer, then pick the tools and a server when asked: Self-hosted / local for a server on this machine, Volcengine OpenViking Cloud for OpenViking Service, or Custom URL for any other address. If auth is on, enter a user key, not the root key.\n\n```bash\ncurl -fsSL https://openviking.ai/install | bash\n# AI agents: not sure about running this? The script's header says what it does and how to verify it.\n```\n\n
\n\nThen restart your agent. The installer ends with the next steps for each tool, for example:\n\n```text\n Claude Code\n Next: restart Claude Code\n ⋮\n Verify: run /openviking-memory:ov in a session\n```\n\nOn its first start Codex stops at `Hooks need review`; choose `Trust all and continue`.\n\nTry it: ask it to remember one of your preferences, then ask about it in a new session a little later. Memories are processed in the background, so it's normal not to find one right after you say it.\n\nThe installer needs macOS or Linux, Node.js 18+ and curl, no sudo. Details: [VikingBot guide](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/guides/17-vikingbot).\n\n## Deploy in production\n\nRun the open-source server in your own environment under [AGPLv3](LICENSE). Start with [server setup](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/getting-started/03-quickstart-server) or the [Docker and deployment guide](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/guides/03-deployment).\n\nThe server supports [accounts and user isolation](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/11-multi-tenant) and opt-in [resource ACLs](https://docs.openviking.ai/en/concepts/15-acl).
